{{Quote|I am Doctor Tabo, the aforementioned "maniac"&mdash;though it's a rather specious claim.|Tabo|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Tabo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] employed at the [[Sundari Research Grounds]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Hoping to weaponize the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] that the facility was studying, he sabotaged the facility's experiments tampering the suppressive implants and causing the Colicoids to break free and begin killing the staff. Tabo sealed the survivors in and fled to safety, though [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces discovered a recording from Doctor [[Arick Tamso]] that proved Tabo's guilt. Tabo tried to bribe the Republic forces to bring him the implants, but they refused.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Tabo appears in the Heroic mission "Colicoid Massacre" for Republic players in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. If players choose the dark side option, they deliver the Colicoid implants to Tabo.<ref name="TOR" />
